title: Mentha x piperita tea for medicinal use
intro: Mentha x piperita tea is a herbal preparation made from the dried leaves and stems of the peppermint plant. It is commonly used in herbalism for its soothing and cooling effects on the body. This tea is often consumed to relieve digestive issues such as bloating, gas, and indigestion. It can also help alleviate headaches, reduce stress, and soothe sore throats. Peppermint tea is valued for its aromatic and therapeutic properties in traditional and modern herbal medicine.
